tok 1.0 "Intake workflow"

pool institute "Mental Health Care Institute"
  lane family_doctor "Family doctor"
    start needed "Notice needed"
    task notice "Notice by telephone"
    task send_copy "Send a copy of the medical file"
  lane secretarial "Secretarial office"
    task inquire "Inquire after the name and residence of the patient"
    task put_through "Put the doctor through to the nursing officer"
    task store "Store the information on the form in the information system"
    task print "Print the information"
    xor new_patient "New patient?"
    task create_file "Create a patient file"
    xor new_patient_join "New patient checked?"
    task store_docs "Store the registration form and the print in the patient file"
    task produce_cards "Produce two registration cards"
    task add_notices "Add the new patient to the list of new notices"
    task store_assignments "Store the assignment of each patient in the information system"
    task pass_cards "Pass the registration cards to the first and second intaker"
    and split_intake "Start intake meetings"
    xor medical_required "Medical file required?"
    task prepare_letter "Prepare and send a letter to the family doctor requesting a copy of the medical file"
    task receive_copy "Receive a copy of the medical file"
    task inform_second "Inform the second intaker"
    task add_copy "Add the copy to the patient file"
    xor medical_merge "Medical file checked?"
    task type_tapes "Type out the tapes"
    task add_taped_info "Add the information to the patient file"
    task status_list "Put the patient on the list of patients that reach this status"
    task provide_list "Provide the team-leader with a list of these patients"
    and meetings_done "Meetings completed"
  lane nursing_officer "Nursing officer"
    task full_inquiry "Make a full inquiry into the mental, health, and social state"
    task record_form "Record the information on a registration form"
    task hand_form "Hand in the registration form at the secretarial office"
  lane team_leader "Team-leader"
    task hold_meeting "Hold a staff meeting of the medical team"
    task assign "Assign all new patients on the list to members of the team"
    task record_assignment_list "Record the assignments on an assignment list"
    task hand_assignment_list "Hand the assignment list to the secretarial office"
  lane social_worker "Social-medical worker"
    task first_plan "Plan a meeting with the patient"
    task first_examine "Examine the patient using a standard checklist"
    task first_observe "Register additional observations in a personal notebook"
    task first_notes "Put a copy of the notes in the patient file"
    task first_checklist "Add the standard checklist to the patient file"
  lane physician "Physician"
    task second_plan "Plan the first meeting"
    task second_meet "Meet with the patient"
    task second_record "Record observations using a dictaphone"
  lane psychiatrist "Psychiatrist"
    task formulate_plan "Formulate a treatment plan"
    end ended "Intake procedure ended"
